learning_outcomes.text: Understand the challenges and critical aspects specific to the development of "real-time" applications.
Acquire the fundamentals of real-time programming.
Design a real-time embedded system while ensuring compliance with the requirements set forth in a specification document.
Understand the specific mechanisms of real-time systems (task scheduling, recovery time, latency, etc.).
Know how to define a priority policy among different processes, and select a scheduling policy.
Be aware of the limitations of the equipment used.
Be able to define and carry out performance validation tests.

syllabus_topics: Definition of latency and recovery times
Introduction to a real-time operating system on an Atmel microcontroller
Presentation of a specification document and design of a system to meet its requirements
